transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's really nice to meet you too. Um... I guess my mom mostly wanted me to come in. I hope it's okay that I'm here. 

I just... I don't want to sound lazy or anything, I promise I'm not, but lately I just can't seem to make myself do anything anymore. I used to knit a lot, and write in my journal, and go for walks, but... I don't know. Now I mostly just sit in my room. It's kind of embarrassing to admit, and I feel really bad about it, but sometimes I just stay in the same clothes for a while. I just don't have the energy to change. And when my mom asks what's wrong, I feel awful because I barely even have the energy to answer her. 

I'm really trying to be better about it, though. Is that... does that make sense?
Have you been feeling down or sad most days?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think I'm sad. I'm not crying all the time or anything like that. I know it probably sounds like I am, with the sitting around and everything, but it's not a sad feeling. It's more just... empty, I guess? 

I hope that doesn't sound weird. I'm really not trying to be difficult, I just... I don't feel down in the way you'd think. I just don't feel much of anything at all. Is that... is that okay to say? I don't want to give you the wrong answer.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like knitting or going for walks?

Um... yeah, I think so. I know I mentioned them a minute ago, I'm sorry if I'm repeating myself. I just... I don't really pick up my knitting needles at all anymore, and I don't go out for walks or write in my journal. 

It's not that I decided I hate doing those things, I just... mostly I just sit in my room. Sometimes in the same clothes, which I know sounds really gross, I'm sorry. I just can't seem to make myself do anything. Even when my mom comes in to ask what's wrong, I barely have the energy to give her an answer. 

I hope I'm explaining this right. I don't want to sound like I'm just making excuses... is that what you meant by losing interest?
Have you ever had another time in your life when you felt this same way for a couple of weeks or longer, and then it got better?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I felt a little tired, like anyone else, but... never like this. Not for weeks at a time. 

I've always been pretty good about keeping up with things, I promise. This is... this is really the first time I've ever felt so stuck. I really hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is, but... yeah, it's never been like this before. Does that... is that a helpful answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Did something stressful happen around the time this started?

Um... no, not really. I mean, nothing big or... or terrible happened, I don't think. I'm sorry, I wish I could give you a better reason for why I'm like this right now. 

I know it probably seems like there should be some big dramatic event, like a fight or something, but... no. Everything was just normal, I guess. I hope that's an okay answer. I just... I don't want you to think I'm hiding anything from you, because I'm really not. Is it bad if nothing stressful happened?
Have you been feeling anxious or worried a lot lately?

Um... no, I don't think I have. I mean, I'm not really worried about much of anything right now. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound like I don't care about things, I promise I do! It's just... mostly I just feel really blank, like I mentioned before. I don't get that nervous, racing feeling that people get when they're anxious. 

I hope that's an okay answer. I'm sorry if you were looking for something else, I just want to be completely honest with you. Is it alright that I'm not feeling anxious? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don't?

Um... no, definitely not. I haven't seen anything or heard anything strange, I promise. 

I know some people get really sick and have things like that happen, but... my mind isn't playing tricks on me or anything. I'm completely normal that way, I swear. 

I hope you believe me. I just... I wouldn't want you to think I'm crazy or making things up. I'm just trying to be a good patient and tell you exactly what's going on. Is that... is that what you needed to know? I hope I answered that okay.
Have you been feeling guilty about things in a way that seems much bigger or more extreme than what actually happened?

Um... no, not at all. I haven't done anything bad to feel guilty about, I promise. 

I try really hard to be a good person and do the right things, so... there hasn't been anything like that. I don't want you to think I'm hiding some awful secret or that I've hurt anyone, because I haven't. I've just been... keeping to myself, mostly.

I hope it's okay that I don't have those feelings. I'm really trying to give you the right answers... is it helpful that I'm not feeling guilty? I just want to make sure I'm being a good patient for you.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of wanting to die?

Um... no, definitely not. I haven't had any thoughts like that at all. 

I know sometimes people feel that way when they're really sad or struggling, but... I would never want to do anything to hurt myself, I promise. I value my life, even if things feel a little weird or blank right now. I just... I don't want you to think I'm a danger to myself or anything like that. 

I'm really trying to get better and do whatever you think is best. I hope that's the right answer... is it a good sign that I'm not having those kinds of thoughts? I just want to make sure I'm doing everything I can to be helpful today.
Have other people noticed that you’re moving or speaking much more slowly than usual?

Um... no, nobody has said anything like that to me. I don't think I'm moving slow or talking slow at all. 

I mean, I'm just sitting here talking to you normally, right? I try to keep up and be polite and answer as quickly as I can. I wouldn't want to waste your time or make anyone wait on me. I've just been... resting a bit more maybe, since I'm not working or anything right now, but I'm definitely not moving like a zombie or anything weird like that. I promise.

I hope I'm talking at a good speed for you. Am I... am I making sense and answering fast enough? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right so you can help me.
Because of this, have you been unable to take care of basic things like washing yourself or eating regular meals?

Um... no, no, I've been taking care of myself. I really have. 

I know it's important to stay clean and eat, so I make sure I do. I mean, maybe I don't eat huge meals every single day, but I'm definitely eating. And I shower and brush my teeth... I wouldn't want to come in here looking messy or smelling bad, that would be so disrespectful to you. I try really hard to keep up with all of that. 

I hope I look okay today? I tried to make sure I was presentable for our appointment. I'm really trying to do all the right things... is it okay that I'm managing that part alright?
